body.para: Displays a message and pauses the program until a key is pressed or until a time-out occurs. This is the FoxPro version of the WAIT command.
<cMessage>The message to display. When this is omitted, the text "Press any key to continue..." is displayed. When the WINDOW clause is used and the message is omitted, no message is displayed.
TO <Variable>The variable that receives the key that was pressed. When no key was pressed (NOWAIT, TIMEOUT, or when the program is not interactive) the variable receives an empty string.

WINDOW [AT <nRow>, <nColumn>]Displays the message in a window instead of on the screen. When the program is a GUI program, the message is displayed in a message box. The position is only used when it is supported by the window.
NOWAITDisplays the message and continues the program immediately, without waiting for a key.
NOCLEARLeaves the message window open after the command has finished. Use WAIT CLEAR to close it.
TIMEOUT <nSeconds>The number of seconds to wait for a key before the command continues.
The WAIT command returns an empty string and does not wait when the program does not have a console or a user interface (for example in a service).

WAIT "Continue?" TO cKey
WAIT WINDOW "Please wait..." NOWAIT
WAIT "Press a key within 5 seconds" TIMEOUT 5
